good.last_message: This can't be met as written. A CR2032 holds about 225 mAh (0.68 Wh). A GPS fix plus an LTE-M uplink every 10 s averages roughly 50 mW, so the cell lasts about 14 hours, not 2 years: short by roughly 1000x. Which would you like to relax: the fix interval, the battery (e.g. 2x AA lithium), or the lifetime?
